descriptionUser: Download an archive of everything you created and received in SuperApp6: profile, tasks, notes, calendar, files, chats and finances. It is built in the background — we will notify you when it is ready. The archive is kept for 7 days, each part can be downloaded up to 5 times, and every download asks for an SMS code.
descriptionWorkspace: An archive of all organization data: people and structure, documents, tasks, chats, counterparties, finances and files. Fields protected by visibility rules come exactly as you see them. The archive is kept for 7 days, each part can be downloaded up to 5 times with an SMS code.
ownerOnly: Only the owner can request the organization archive
emptyText: Request an archive — we will notify you when it is ready.
requesterDownloads: Only the person who requested the archive downloads it
expiredText: The archive has expired — request a new one

errors.owner_mismatch: A consistency check stopped the build
errors.quota: The daily export limit of the plan is used up
errors.subject_gone: The account or organization is no longer active
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side

stepUpBody: The archive holds personal data. Enter your password and the code from SMS — the confirmation lasts 15 minutes.
